notes: Connected OSM course candidate. The selected loop is the longest simple source-node cycle after explicit exclusions; its association with a named circuit configuration requires review.
Source way order and shared node IDs are retained. No nearby endpoints are joined and no reference boundaries are read.
Some source ways lack one-way direction tags. Travel direction is provisional.

This provisional source route follows the western pit lane, not an operator-confirmed racing configuration. Estimated road-limit joins at the pit merges, northern forecourt and inner branch remain inferred. No operator nominal dimensions or bank angles are fitted.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 35 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Draft native-image road-limit estimates on the retained OSM course candidate.38 cross-sections read from dated PNOA2023 orthophotography. The source uses the western pit lane, not an operator-confirmed racing configuration. The pit merge near stations80-110, inner branch at540 and upper pit/forecourt return at720-0 include inferred virtual joins; these are not independent measured limits. Sparse offsets follow the source normals, with approximate curb/paint limits and image reading uncertainty. No nominal width, operator lap length or bank angle is fitted. Curbs illustrative, terrain estimated and course direction provisional.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
